Careers at Notion

At Notion, every role contributes to something we take seriously: helping teams think and work better—now with AI in the room. We build with craft and judgment, focused on work that compounds. You'll have real ownership and be expected to move with urgency and care.

Browse full-time openings
Play
Our story

Early computing pioneers envisioned tools that could expand what people can create and extend our intellect. Notion exists to make that practical: software you can shape to fit how you think and work.

Notion can feel like a blank page or a powerful database. That range is intentional. We help teams turn scattered ideas, projects, and knowledge into a shared system with enough structure to actually run on.

As AI accelerates how much work gets created, the advantage shifts to teams who keep context connected and decisions crisp. We’re building a collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together, holding the same bar for craft and clarity Notion has always held.

We build as customer zero, bringing this future of work to life with human judgment and durable systems we won’t compromise on.

While the sports cars roll off the production line in Stuttgart and Leipzig, Porsche Deutschland GmbH manages the sales in its home market of Germany from Bietigheim-Bissingen.

Close to the customer. Close to the product. The Porsche Centers are always looking for talented people, specialists and executives who want to shift up a gear — and who share one thing above all: enthusiasm for the Porsche brand.

Thinking strategically. Acting pragmatically. The experts at Porsche Consulting work from 12 locations worldwide and support companies in improving their performance and innovative strength.
